mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_id , i.user_id , i.category , i.`status` , i.title , i.created_at , i.ui_client , i.ui_version , i.api_version , m.message_id AS msg_message_id , m.inquiry_id AS msg_inquiry_id , m.seq AS msg_seq , m.sender_type AS msg_sender_type , m.body AS msg_body , m.created_at AS msg_created_at FROM t_inquiry i LEFT JOIN t_inquiry_message m ON i.inquiry_id = m.inquiry_id WHERE i.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} ORDER BY m.seq ASC

SELECT inquiry_id , user_id , category , `status` , title , create_user_id , create_program , created_at , update_user_id , update_program , updated_at FROM t_inquiry WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT i.inquiry_id, i.user_id, u.email AS user_email, u.display_name AS user_display_name, i.category, i.status, i.title, i.created_at, i.updated_at, COUNT(m.message_id) AS total_message_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.sender_type = 'USER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS user_message_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.sender_type = 'AI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ai_message_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.sender_type = 'STAFF' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_message_count FROM t_inquiry i INNER JOIN m_user u ON i.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN t_inquiry_message m ON i.inquiry_id = m.inquiry_id
GROUP BY i.inquiry_id, i.user_id, u.email, u.display_name, i.category, i.status, i.title, i.created_at, i.updated_at
mapper.select:
WHERE i.status = '20'
ORDER BY i.created_at ASC

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY AS d UNION ALL SELECT d + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM date_series WHERE d < CURDATE() ) SELECT ds.d AS date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS open, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ai_answered, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '20' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_staff, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS staff_answered, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '90' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN t_inquiry i ON DATE(i.created_at) = ds.d GROUP BY ds.d ORDER BY ds.d ASC

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY AS d UNION ALL SELECT d + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM date_series WHERE d < CURDATE() ) SELECT ds.d AS date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.sender_type = 'USER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS user, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.sender_type = 'AI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ai, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.sender_type = 'STAFF' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS staff FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN t_inquiry_message m ON DATE(m.created_at) = ds.d GROUP BY ds.d ORDER BY ds.d ASC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = '00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ai_answered, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '20' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_staff, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_answered, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '00' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 3 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stale_unclosed_open, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '10' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 3 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stale_unclosed_ai_answered, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '20' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 3 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stale_unclosed_pending_staff, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '25' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 3 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stale_unclosed_staff_answered FROM t_inquiry WHERE status != '90'
